title: I Used the VR-Headset Hygiene Log on the Attendant Who Skipped the Wipe

parts.text: I scanned headset 3 at 3:44 p.m. and attendant Niko handed it with last session still on the foam. The card said: WIPE THE FOAM. LOG THE WIPE. NO SKIP. I was twenty-two, ticket holder, holding a hygiene card. Niko shrugged. "Turns are the wipe." I photographed the foam, the card, and the empty log line. Then I asked for the wipe log. At 3:50 the floor lead pinged why Niko's name was on a skipped wipe. I did not argue the joke. I argued the file. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The floor lead can see Niko's skipped wipe on headset 3 in the hygiene log.

social.video_title: The attendant handed a headset with last-session foam — Part 1/2
social.description: VR arcade, a hygiene card, an empty log line. I logged the skip. Would you have asked for the wipe log?

parts.text: Niko called it a rush until the lead asked for the still. I printed the log, the card, and the photo. The foam wiped. Niko logged every turn and told the next attendant rushes were always about optics. Optics is a word attendants use when foam exists. Hygiene now has a second line: TURNS ARE NOT THE WIPE. I keep headset 3. Niko brown-bags the jokes. The bay finally looks like a card, not a shortcut. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.

social.description: Wipe log, cleaned foam, and a second line. Was a rush ever the foam?
